name: German Open 2020
information:
# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.
In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held every year since so that the German Open 2020 already represent the 17th edition of this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun!
